Many homes in Orland Park, from brick ranches in Fernway to the 1990s two-stories in Eagle Ridge, feature attached two- or three-car garages. Insulated carriage-style doors common in Crystal Tree also rely on stable, well-maintained tracks. Freezing temperatures and ground shifts can misalign tracks or cause components to warp. January typically sees the most track repair calls in Orland Park. We understand these specific local challenges. Our technicians address the specific wear and tear Orland Park weather causes on garage door tracks.

problemSigns.detail: Your garage door struggles or stops at the same point during opening or closing. This indicates an obstruction or misalignment in the track.

problemSigns.sign: Visible bend or dent in track
problemSigns.detail: Inspect your vertical or horizontal tracks for any obvious damage. Even a small bend can impede roller movement and cause friction.
If rollers are dislodged, the track is likely bent, misaligned, or has a broken bracket. This prevents the door from moving correctly.

problemSigns.sign: Gap between track and door frame
problemSigns.detail: A visible gap suggests loose or broken track brackets or fasteners. This misalignment can cause the door to drag or jam.

After the repair, we perform a balance test and safety-reverse test. This ensures your garage door operates safely and smoothly.
